$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Instagram Reels delivery: safe zones + encode contract. Read by engine/src/core/safe.tsx (TypeScript) and scripts/lib/ig.mjs (Node). Every number carries a `basis`: official = quoted from a live Meta page on 2026-09-01; derived = arithmetic from an official percentage on the 1080x1920 canvas; community = measured by third parties from the live app / Meta's safe-zone checker file (Meta publishes NO organic pixel figures); engine = a choice this project made. Zone semantics: content must satisfy y >= top, y < bottom, x >= left, x < right; if `rail` is set, additionally NOT (x >= rail.x && y >= rail.y). All values are delivery pixels on 1080x1920.

ig-reels-ads.label: Instagram Reels ads safe zone (Meta official: top 14%, bottom 35%, sides 6%)
ig-reels-ads.quote: Consider leaving at least 14% of the top, 35% of the bottom, and 6% on each side of your asset free from text, logos, or other important creative elements.

ig-reels-ads-disclaimer.label: Instagram Reels ads WITH disclaimers (Meta official: bottom 40%)
ig-reels-ads-disclaimer.quote: If you're including disclaimers on your Reels ads, you should leave the bottom 40% of your ad free from text, logos and other key creative elements.

ig-reels-organic.label: Instagram Reels organic UI (community-measured: header 250, caption block 450, action rail 227 px from y 1150)
ig-reels-organic.basis: community: Meta publishes no organic pixel/percentage figures (help.instagram.com/1038071743007909 and the @instagramforbusiness safe-zone post carry none). top 250 / bottom 450 measured from the live app (adkit.so, March 2026); rail 227 px wide starting 1150 px from the top traced from Meta's safe-zone-checker-2023-08-24 file (cadenus.io, July 2026) -> rail.x = 1080-227 = 853; sides 65 = the official 6% ad margin applied to organic (engine choice)
ig-reels-organic.quote: Build your reels with these safe zones in mind so your products and messages don't get covered by text or the Instagram interface. (no numeric values published)

legacy-02.label: Zones used by the first two projects before this spec existed (kept for regression comparison only)
legacy-02.basis: engine: retained legacy profile values for compatibility

cover.$comment: Where the cover frame survives Instagram's crops. Official: the Reels tab uses the middle-most 9:16; a feed share uses the middle-most 1:1 square (Graph API). The profile grid moved to a taller crop in Jan 2025 (3:4 per press, no Meta page found) -> derived centred 1080x1440.

recommendedUploadPx.basis: official: help.instagram.com/1038071743007909 'recommended size for cover photos is 420px by 654px (or 1:1.55 ratio)'

resolution.basis: official: Graph API 'Maximum columns (horizontal pixels): 1920'; FB Reels help 'Recommended resolution: 1080p'; Ads Guide recommends 1440x2560 for ads (same 9:16)

fps.basis: official: help.instagram.com 'minimum frame rate of 30 FPS'; Graph API 'Frame rate: 23-60 FPS'; Ads Guide 'fixed frame rate'. Engine rule: the delivery rate must divide the plate's REAL motion rate evenly (30 for a 30-real plate, 50 for a genuine 50 fps plate, 60 only for genuine 60) - never a 1.667:1 cadence

codec.name: h264
codec.basis: official: Ads Guide 'H.264 compression', Graph API 'HEVC or H264, progressive scan, closed GOP, 4:2:0'; profile/level are community convention (Meta names neither)

pixelFormat.basis: official for 4:2:0 (Graph API, FB Reels help); bt709 SDR is Meta's pipeline target (engineering.fb.com 2023-07-17 'target SDR colorspace (BT.709)'); explicit VUI tags are an engine rule because Remotion's default output is tagged yuvj420p/pc/bt470bg with unknown primaries/transfer

bitrate.basis: official max: Graph API 'Video bitrate: VBR, 25Mbps maximum'. target/VBV are ENGINE choices (Meta publishes no recommended video bitrate)

gop.basis: official: FB Reels help 'Closed GOP recommended: 2s to 5s'; Graph API 'closed GOP'

audio.basis: official: Graph API 'AAC, 48khz sample rate maximum, 1 or 2 channels', 'Audio bitrate: 128kbps'; FB Reels help 'AAC Low Complexity, Stereo, 44.1kHz or 48kHz, 128kbs+'. 320k is the engine's render bitrate (above the floor)

container.basis: official: Graph API 'MOV or MP4, no edit lists, moov atom at the front of the file'; Ads Guide 'should not contain edit lists or special boxes'

durationSec.basis: official: Ads Guide '0 seconds to 15 minutes'; Graph API '15 mins maximum, 3 seconds minimum'; help.instagram.com 'clips that add up to 20 minutes' and 'Reels over 3 minutes won't be recommended to new audiences'

fileSize.basis: official: Graph API 'File size: 300MB maximum'; Ads Guide 'Maximum File Size: 4GB'; organic in-app cap not published

loudness.basis: engine: delivery audio target; Meta publishes no loudness spec

sources.what: ads safe zone 14/35/6, 1440x2560, H.264, fixed frame rate, AAC 128kbps+, 15 min, 4GB, no edit lists
shared 9:16 safe zone across Stories/Reels/Feed, 40% bottom with disclaimers, zoom/letterbox on tall screens
container/moov/no edit lists, codec, 23-60 fps, 25 Mbps max, 15 min, 300 MB, AAC 48k 128k, cover crops
aspect 1.91:1-9:16, minimum 30 fps, minimum 720 px, cover 420x654
up to 20 minutes; over 3 minutes not recommended to new audiences
Facebook Reels: H.264/H.265, 24-60 fps, closed GOP 2-5 s, 4:2:0, AAC-LC stereo 44.1/48 kHz 128 kbps+
rail 227 px wide from y 1150, traced from Meta's checker file
top 250 / bottom 450 measured from live previews (March 2026)
